steps: Layer half the yogurt, granola, and berries. Repeat.

Banana Pudding:
- 1 can sweetened condensed milk
- 1 1/2 cups cold water
- 1 package instant vanilla pudding
- 3 cups heavy cream
- 1 box Nilla wafers
- 5 ripe bananas, sliced

- Whisk the milk, water, and pudding until smooth
- Chill until firm, 1–2 hours
- Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold in the pudding
- Layer pudding, wafers, and bananas, ending with pudding
- Chill, then garnish with a few wafers
Buffalo Chicken Dip:
- 2 cans chunk chicken, drained
- 3/4 cup hot sauce
- 2 packages cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup ranch dressing
- 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar
- celery and crackers, for serving

- Heat the chicken and hot sauce, 3–5 minutes
- Stir in the cream cheese and ranch until warm
- Mix in half the cheddar and top with the rest
- Slow cooker on Low, about 35 minutes
- Serve warm

ingredients.name: fine sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Overlap the tomato, mozzarella, and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

Chipotle Mayonnaise:
- 1 cup mayonnaise
- 1 canned chipotle pepper in adobo
- 2 teaspoons adobo sauce
- 1 teaspoon lime juice
- salt

- Blend until smooth
- Keep in the fridge up to a week

steps: Stir everything together.
Roll into balls.
Freeze about 1 hour, until set. Keep in the fridge up to a week.

Garbanzo Beans:
- 1 pound dried chickpeas
- salt
- bay leaf, garlic, and onion

- Pick through, rinse, and soak at least 8 hours
- Cover with fresh water. Add the salt and aromatics
- Simmer 1 1/2–2 hours, until tender

ingredients.name: fukujinzuke (Japanese red pickled vegetables)
ingredients.note: optional; or make my Homemade Fukujinzuke

steps: Cut the onions into wedges, the carrots into chunks, and the potatoes into quarters.
Grate the ginger, garlic, and apple. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Cook the onions in the oil about 5 minutes, until tender.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the chicken, until the outside is no longer pink.
Add the stock, apple, honey, soy sauce, ketchup, carrots, and potatoes.
Simmer until the carrots and potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Skim the foam.
Turn off the heat. Dissolve the curry roux in a ladle of the liquid, then stir it in.
Simmer 5–10 minutes, until thick.
Serve with rice.

Mexican Rice:
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 1/2 large onion, chopped
- 2 cups long grain rice
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 can diced tomatoes and green chiles
- 1 can whole tomatoes
- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- 1 teaspoon salt
- cilantro

- Cook the onion 3–4 minutes
- Add the rice and garlic and cook 3 minutes
- Stir in the tomatoes and cook 2 minutes
- Add the broth, salt, and cumin. Boil, then cover and simmer 10–15 minutes
- Top with cilantro
Pickles:
- 1 1/4 cups distilled white vinegar
- 3 tablespoons kosher salt
- 2 tablespoons sugar
- 2 cups cold water
- 1 3/4–2 pounds Kirby cucumbers, halved or speared
- 2 tablespoons coriander seeds
- 6 garlic cloves, halved
- 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
- 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
- 16 dill sprigs

- Heat the vinegar, salt, and sugar until dissolved. Stir in the cold water and chill
- Pack the cucumbers, spices, and brine into two quart jars
- Refrigerate about 24 hours
- Keeps about 1 month
Pizza:
- 2 teaspoons yeast
- 7/8–1 1/8 cups lukewarm water
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/4 teaspoons salt

- If using active dry yeast, dissolve it in 2 tablespoons of the water until foamy, about 15 minutes
- Mix and knead into a soft dough, about 4–5 minutes
- Rise until puffy, about 1 hour for instant yeast or 90 minutes for active dry
- Shape, top, and bake
Sloppy Joes:
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1/2 cup minced carrots
- 1 cup chopped onion
- 1/2 cup chopped celery
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 1/4 pounds ground beef
- 1/2 cup ketchup
- 2 cups tomato sauce
- 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
- 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
- 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar
- pinch cloves, 1/2 teaspoon thyme, pinch cayenne, salt and pepper
- 4 hamburger buns

- Cook the carrots in the oil 5 minutes. Add the onion and celery for 5 minutes more, then the garlic for 30 seconds
- Brown the beef. Leave about 1 tablespoon of fat
- Stir in the ketchup, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, vinegar, brown sugar, and spices
- Simmer on medium-low for 10 minutes
- Serve on the buns
Baked Sweet Potato (Vegan):
- sweet potatoes

Baked
- Poke holes with a fork
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 40–50 minutes
- Serve with toppings

ingredients.name: soy sauce, tamari, or liquid aminos
cloves minced garlic (optional and to taste)
large or 4 small portobello mushroom caps, stems trimmed and gills removed
small eggplant or 1 baby eggplant, sliced crosswise into 1/2 inch slices
large or 2 small red bell peppers, cut into 2-inch strips
large or 2 small red onions, sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch slices

steps: Whisk the marinade.
Marinate the vegetables at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Grill over medium-high, 6–10 minutes, turning until tender.
Or roast at 425 degrees for 25–35 minutes, flipping halfway.
Pile onto toasted buns.

Buffalo Cauliflower Wings (Vegan):
- 2/3 cup flour
- 1/4 cup cornstarch
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon onion powder
- 1 teaspoon paprika
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 3/4 cup water
- 1 cauliflower, in large florets
- buffalo sauce

Baked
- Whisk the dry ingredients and water. Coat the florets
- Oven: 450 degrees
- Time: 10 minutes, flip, then 10 minutes more
- Brush with buffalo sauce
- Time: 12–15 minutes more, until crisp

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: sliced into squares, plus more for greasing the baking dish

steps: Butter a 9x13.
Peel and slice the sweet potatoes 1/2 inch thick.
Melt the butter with the sugars, spices, and salt. Stir in the vanilla.
Coat the potatoes with the syrup.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
Uncover, toss, and bake 30–40 minutes more, until tender and syrupy.

ingredients.name: large egg (50 g each w/o shell)
chicken stock/broth
ingredients.note: for vegan/vegetarian, use vegetable broth or Vegan Dashi

ingredients.name: ponzu
ingredients.note: or make my Homemade Ponzu recipe

ingredients.name: cooked Japanese short-grain rice
ingredients.note: or precooked udon / ramen noodles; for the final course

steps: Mix the chicken, egg, scallion, ginger, soy sauce, panko, and cornstarch. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Cut the chicken, cod, tofu, pork, cabbage, carrot, negi, scallions, and mushrooms into bite-size pieces. Peel the shrimp.
Simmer the stock, sake, mirin, garlic, and ginger.
Dissolve the miso in a little broth, stir it back in, and take the pot off the heat before it boils.
Simmer the fish, tofu, cabbage, negi, carrots, and mushrooms about 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs and remaining meat and vegetables. Simmer about 10 minutes more.
Serve with ponzu or sesame sauce. Finish the broth with rice or noodles for 2–3 minutes.

ingredients.name: large egg (50 g each w/o shell)
chicken stock/broth
ingredients.note: for vegan/vegetarian, use vegetable broth or Vegan Dashi

ingredients.name: ponzu
ingredients.note: or make my Homemade Ponzu recipe

ingredients.name: cooked Japanese short-grain rice
ingredients.note: or precooked udon / ramen noodles; for the final course

steps: Mix the chicken, egg, scallion, ginger, soy sauce, panko, and cornstarch. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Cut the chicken, cod, tofu, pork, cabbage, carrot, negi, scallions, and mushrooms into bite-size pieces. Peel the shrimp.
Simmer the stock, sake, mirin, garlic, and ginger.
Dissolve the miso in a little broth, stir it back in, and take the pot off the heat before it boils.
Simmer the fish, tofu, cabbage, negi, carrots, and mushrooms about 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs and remaining meat and vegetables. Simmer about 10 minutes more.
Serve with ponzu or sesame sauce. Finish the broth with rice or noodles for 2–3 minutes.

ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt and black pepper, to taste
water (or 4 cups vegetable broth + 2 cups water)
kale, de-stemmed and torn in pieces
ce from 1/2 of a small lemon (or a whole lemon, depending how much lemon flavor you prefer)

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in a little water for 2 minutes.
Add the celery, carrots, broccoli, tomatoes, and ginger. Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Add the rest of the water. Simmer 10–15 minutes, until the vegetables are soft.
Add the kale, cabbage, and lemon juice for the last 2–3 minutes.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.note: cellophane, ramen, udon, or soba 5.3 oz

steps: Pour the hot oil over the garlic and ginger. Stir in the curry paste, parsley, tahini, and soy sauce.
Boil the noodles. Add the bok choy for the last 2 minutes. Save the cooking water.
Cook the dumplings until tender.
Whisk about 3 cups of the hot water into the flavor base. Add more to taste.
Divide the noodles, bok choy, and dumplings. Pour on the broth and add toppings.

Fermented Beets:
- enough beets to fill a quart jar
- 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
- 1 tablespoon salt per cup of non-chlorinated water

- Peel and slice the beets
- Pack the jar, leaving 1–1 1/2 inches of headspace. Add the mustard seeds
- Dissolve the salt in water and pour it over the beets. Keep them submerged
- Ferment at room temperature a few days, until bubbly. Burp the jar daily if it is sealed tight
Flour Tortillas:
- 3 cups flour
- 1 teaspoon kosher salt
- 1 1/4 teaspoons baking powder
- 1 cup just-boiled water
- 1/3 cup melted butter

- Mix the flour, salt, and baking powder
- Stir in the butter and water until no dry flour remains
- Knead about 30 seconds. Rest, covered, 15 minutes
- Divide into 8–10 pieces and roll them thin
- Cook in a dry pan over medium-low, about 2 minutes a side, until bubbles form

steps: Whisk the half-and-half, egg, vanilla, salt, and cinnamon.
Soak each side of the bread for 2 minutes.
Cook in butter over medium heat, 4 minutes, then 3–4 minutes on the other side.
Serve with maple syrup.
Season the chicken with oregano, paprika, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Cook in olive oil about 5 minutes a side, until 165 degrees. Set aside.
Cook half the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano, and salt about 2 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then the rice, chickpeas, lemon juice, and remaining tomatoes.
Toss the feta with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano. Stir half into the rice.
Add the chicken and top with the rest of the feta.
Toss the chicken with the cornstarch.
Whisk the honey, broth, soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic powder.
Sear the chicken in oil over medium-high, 3–5 minutes a side. Work in batches.
Off the heat, add the sauce. Return the chicken and cook on medium until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through.

Kvass (Probiotic Drink):
- 1 pound fresh fruit or fruit scraps
- 1/4 cup sugar
- 3–4 cups water

- Put the fruit in a clean jar
- Dissolve the sugar in the water and pour it over the fruit
- Ferment at room temperature 1–4 days, stirring daily
- Refrigerate
Naan:
- 2 cups flour
- 1 tablespoon sugar
- 1 teaspoon instant yeast
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 3 tablespoons plain yogurt
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3/4 cup warm water
- 2 tablespoons melted butter

- Mix the dry ingredients
- Stir in the yogurt, oil, and water. Knead just until it comes together
- Rise until doubled, 1–1 1/2 hours
- Divide into pieces, roll thin, and cook in a hot dry pan until blistered
- Brush with butter

ingredients.name: bone-in chicken pieces
ingredients.note: I used a fryer pack, 8 pieces total.

steps: Warm the pickle juice, dissolve the sugar, and brine the chicken at least 1 hour.
Mix the buttermilk and hot sauce. Mix the flour, cornstarch, and creole seasoning.
Coat in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Heat the oil to 350 degrees. Fry in batches 7–8 minutes, until 165 inside.
Hold the fried chicken at 250 degrees.
Stir the cayenne, paprika, brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt into 3/4 cup of the fry oil.
Brush the spicy oil on the chicken. Serve on white bread with pickles.

Oven Baked Catfish (Blue Catfish Filet):
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 2 pounds catfish fillets
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- 2 teaspoons parsley
- 2 tablespoons chives
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 4 tablespoons dry white wine

Baked
- Oil the pan. Season both sides of the fish
- Top with the herbs, butter, and wine
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 20 minutes

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: Chicken Stock or Vegetable Broth would also work

steps: Rinse the quinoa.
Boil the quinoa, water, and salt.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes, until the liquid is gone.
Rest, covered, 10 minutes. Fluff and serve.

ingredients.name: chipotle en adobo sauce
ingredients.note: or more if you want it spicy

ingredients.name: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
* For gluten-free be sure to check the labels.

steps: Cook the quinoa in 1 3/4 cups broth.
Cook the garlic in the oil 1–2 minutes. Add the tomato sauce, salt, cumin, broth, and chipotle. Simmer 3–4 minutes.
Mix the quinoa, chiles, corn, beans, cilantro, and 1/2 cup of the cheese.
Spread in a greased 9x12. Top with the sauce and the rest of the cheese.
Cover. Oven: 400 degrees. Time: 20–25 minutes.
Top with avocado, scallions, and cilantro.
Place the salmon skin-side down. Brush with butter and season with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Oven: 375 degrees. Time: about 12 minutes, until 125 inside.
Broil 3–4 minutes, until the top is lightly golden.
Garnish with parsley, dill, and the lemon.
Whisk the eggs, milk, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt.
Soak the bread on both sides.
Cook in butter over medium-low, about 3 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side.
Hold the finished slices in a 195 degree oven while you cook the rest.

Spinach Patties:
- 16 1/2 ounces spinach
- 4 ounces goat cheese or feta
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 cup matzo meal
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon pepper
- oil, for frying
- 4 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
- juice of 2 lemons
- 7 garlic cloves, minced
- 3 bunches cilantro

- Steam the spinach until wilted. Drain and chop
- Mix with the cheese, eggs, matzo meal, salt, and pepper
- Fry patties in a little oil over medium-high until browned
- Simmer the olive oil, stock, lemon juice, garlic, and cilantro, and spoon it over the patties

ingredients.name: cooked beans
ingredients.note: black, kidney, pinto, white beans, or combination

steps: Rinse canned beans.
Heat the beans, tomatoes, bulgur, and taco seasoning. If the bulgur is raw, add 1/2 cup water and cook until tender.
Chop the vegetables.
Fill the tortillas and add salsa or sauce.
For shells, drape the tortillas over the oven rack. Oven: 400 degrees. Time: 5–7 minutes.
Cover the bones with cold water, boil 15–20 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Roast the bones and vegetables at 450 degrees for 30 minutes. Toss and roast 15–30 minutes more.
Cover with water. Add the bay leaves, peppercorns, star anise, cinnamon, and vinegar.
Simmer with the lid ajar at least 8–12 hours, up to 24. Keep everything submerged.
Strain, cool, and lift off the fat.
Refrigerate about 5 days, or freeze up to 6 months.
Cook the celery and carrots in the butter for 3 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the stock, rosemary, thyme, red pepper, salt, and pepper. Add bouillon if it needs more chicken flavor.
Boil, add the noodles, and cook until just tender.
Stir in the chicken and adjust the seasoning.

Mayonnaise:
- 1 cup light-flavored oil
- 1 large egg, room temperature
- 1 garlic clove, minced
- 1 teaspoon lemon juice
- 2 teaspoons mustard powder
- salt

- Pour the oil into a jar. Crack in the egg and let it sink
- Blend on the yolk until the bottom turns creamy, then move the blender through the jar until it emulsifies
- Blend in the garlic, lemon juice, mustard powder, and salt
